div.div:
Connection Status confirms the management path only. An egress
control that permits the sync endpoints and blocks the providers
produces a gateway that registers, reports Healthy, and fails every
request, with nothing in the gateway log at all.
Check 3 is the one that settles it, because it is the only rung that
puts a real prompt through to a provider and back.

div.div:
Hostnames have moved as the product was integrated into Strata
Cloud Manager, and material from before that is still in circulation.
Different sources name different hosts for the same function, and
some record a variable name as though it were a hostname.
Rather than trusting any list, including this one, read the values
out of the deployment in front of you. The chart supplies them as
environment values on the running pod.
